title: Crisis of the Holy Sect
next_chapter_hook: The seven-day deadline approaches, Chen Ji ventures alone into the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, that altar from which no one has ever emerged alive.

text.content: The puppet's final scream echoes through the air, that name like a blunt knife carving into Chen Ji's heart—Chen Nian, only seven days remain. He sits alone in the dim secret chamber, the Tianji Record Fragment hovering silently before him, the prophetic text slowly fading away, as if even Heavenly Secrets refuses to mention this cruel name. The candlelight flickers, stretching and compressing his shadow like his tumultuous emotions. His fingers unconsciously trace the edge of the fragment, and Chen Ji feels an unprecedented suffocation. The Heavenly Fate trembles slightly within him, as if sensing its master's emotional turmoil.

Outside the secret chamber, the Tianqing Sect continues as usual. The grand performance of 'Chen Ji's sudden death' in three days is already prepared—the substitute corpse with a similar build lies in the ice casket at the Back Mountain, its face covered with horrific charred wounds that could deceive anyone. He only needs to be 'discovered' in front of everyone to completely shed his identity and walk the world under another persona. This is his perfectly calculated plan, three years in the making. Ling Yuan's pursuit, the Xuanwu Sect's threat, the Holy Sect's covetousness... all the pieces are falling into place according to his meticulously woven chess game. Yet right now, that piece he desperately tries to protect is slowly fading away on the Holy Sect's altar.

dialogue.content: The Holy Sect is in trouble! Chen Nian's identity has been exposed by the 'Xuanyin Elder'! They say she possesses a Heaven-granted Dao Bone, making her the perfect sacrifice to unseal the Forbidden Grounds! The sacrifice ceremony will be held in three days! I'm trying my best to delay them, but those fanatics won't give me any time... Her voice nearly breaks into sobs at the end. The usually cold and dominant Inner Disciple Senior Fellow now seems like a child with no hope of salvation.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertips tremble slightly. Heaven-granted Dao Bone—he never told anyone that Chen Nian not only possessed the special constitution of 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' but also a natural Dao Bone—a cultivation treasure that even ancient great powers yearned for. No wonder the Holy Sect spared no expense to find her. From the beginning, she was carefully selected as the sacrifice. And he, in order to set up the world and protect the greater chess game, had left his sister alone in the Holy Sect's heartland for three whole years.

Memories surge like a tide. At eight years old, Chen Nian lay burning with fever in his arms, her voice thin as a mosquito's whine: 'Brother, I'm not afraid... as long as you're here.' At twelve, on a snowy night, she stuffed her only half mantou into his hands: 'I'm not hungry, brother needs to grow stronger.' At fifteen, when they parted, she stood at the dilapidated village entrance refusing to look back, yet her voice clearly reached his ears: 'Brother will come find me, right?' What did he answer at that time? He said: 'Definitely.'

dialogue.content: Looks like you received good news? A cold voice emerged from the shadows. Chen Ji spun around to find Ye Qing somehow already standing in the corner of the secret chamber, her black纱 outfit outlining seductive curves, her lips curved in a meaningful smile. She lightly raised her hand, and a jade slip emanating an eerie aura appeared in her palm: 'I received news about Chen Nian's identity being discovered by the Holy Sect's Xuanyin Elder three days ago. I've been waiting for you to come to me.' She twirled the jade slip between her fingers, a complex light flickering in her eyes: 'But you're more resilient than I imagined. The situation is already urgent—why are you still hesitating?'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his gaze sharp as a blade falling upon Ye Qing. He didn't ask why she knew about Chen Nian, nor questioned what she was after. Over three years, he had grown accustomed to this woman's unpredictable way of appearing and disappearing. 'What do you want?' he asked directly, his voice terrifyingly calm. Ye Qing laughed softly, that laughter echoing through the secret chamber with a hint of playfulness: 'Direct. I like dealing with smart people.' She stepped forward: 'The condition to save your sister is simple—you only need to promise me one thing.'

A trace of elusive emotion flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, immediately replaced by cold indifference. 'Help me kill someone.' The words she spoke were calm as water, yet caused the secret chamber's temperature to drop three degrees. 'Who?' 'The Holy Sect's Sect Master.' Ye Qing stated this name casually, as if the supreme demon path ruler she intended to kill was merely an ant she could crush at any moment. She watched Chen Ji's face darken, her smile deepening: 'Don't refuse so hastily. Hear my plan first.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's deal hangs before him—exchange the Holy Sect Master's life for Chen Nian's. This condition is too shocking; Chen Ji must weigh the pros and cons.

choices.description: Since Ye Qing dared to make such an offer, she must have something to rely on. Let's hear her complete plan before making a judgment.
choices.visible_reward: Might obtain the complete plan to rescue Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Her plan might hide other intentions

text.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly, indicating for her to continue. This action caused a flash of surprise in Ye Qing's eyes—she had expected this calculating man to refuse on the spot, never expecting him to be willing to hear her out. 'Interesting,' she murmured, 'It seems your sister's weight in your heart is even heavier than I imagined.'

choices.description: The Holy Sect's Sect Master is a terrifying existence beyond the Nascent Soul Stage; killing him is like throwing an egg against a rock. The risks of this deal far exceed its benefits.
choices.risk_hint: Without Ye Qing's intelligence, rescuing Chen Nian will be a hundred times more difficult

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely watching her with an indifferent gaze. That gaze made Ye Qing's smile freeze for an instant. She had seen too many people grovel, fly into rage, or show boundless greed before her, yet rarely encountered such calm, water-like scrutiny. 'You're testing me,' she quickly realized, 'Afraid I'm setting a trap?'

choices.text: Offer a condition I can accept
choices.description: A direct refusal might sever this connection. Better to put forward my own chips and see where Ye Qing's bottom line lies.
choices.visible_reward: Might find a balance point acceptable to both parties
choices.risk_hint: Exposing one's chips might cause Ye Qing to raise her asking price

dialogue.content:
Kill the Holy Sect Sect Master? Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice as flat as if discussing today's weather. "Are you testing my intelligence, or testing my sincerity?"

He stepped forward, closing the distance with Ye Qing to less than three chi: "What you really want, why not say it directly? Beating around the bush exhausts us both."

text.content:
Ye Qing's smile gradually faded, replaced by a meaningful scrutiny.

"So you're indeed much more interesting than the rumors suggest." She tossed the Jade Slip to Chen Ji. "This contains the complete defensive layout of the Holy Sect and the ceremony ritual. It took me three years and cost me three trusted aides to obtain it."

Her voice suddenly chilled: "But I must remind you of something—the real reason Chen Nian was discovered was not due to some Profound Yin Elder, but because someone betrayed her whereabouts."

dialogue.content:
"That person is currently within the Tianqing Sect."

Ye Qing's words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. A hint of mockery flashed in her eyes. "You think your fake death plan was flawless? Ling Yuan received the news three days ago."

She lightly blew on her fingertips, saying casually: "Don't believe me? Then guess, why could Su Qingyao receive such precise information at such a perfect timing?"

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

text.content:
The air in the secret chamber seemed to freeze.

Various possibilities raced through Chen Ji's mind. Su Qingyao was the Inner Sect Senior Fellow, her information sources must have been carefully screened. If her intelligence itself was a setup targeting him...

No.

He suddenly realized a key point—if Ye Qing knew about Chen Nian, it meant she had an informant within the Holy Sect. Then this intelligence itself might be a double trap designed to test his reaction.

"You're testing me." Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze blazing. "Wanting to see how far I'd go for Chen Nian."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's true intentions gradually surfaced. Chen Ji needed to determine what her ultimate goal was.

choices.description: Since she wants to play psychological warfare, let's be direct and see what she's really scheming.
choices.visible_reward: See clearly Ye Qing's true purpose
choices.risk_hint: After completely burning bridges, might lose her assistance

dialogue.content:
"Test?" Ye Qing laughed lightly, the sound echoing through the secret chamber, carrying genuine appreciation. "Chen Ji, you're the most interesting person I've ever met.

She stepped forward, looking at him directly for the first time: "Indeed, I am testing you. But this is not a trap—I need to know if you're worth me staking everything."

choices.description: Since she wants to see how far he can go, then show her a satisfactory answer—see how she reacts.
choices.visible_cost: Expose how much he cares about Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Make Ye Qing lower her guard and reveal her true purpose
choices.risk_hint: Being exploited for emotional weakness by Ye Qing

text.content:
Chen Ji remained silent for a long time, long enough that Ye Qing thought he wouldn't speak again.

Then he smiled, a smile carrying a sense of resolve: "Chen Nian is the only family I have in this world. If I can't even protect her, what's the point of scheming against the world?"

Ye Qing's eyes flickered slightly. She seemed not to have expected this strategist renowned for his coldness to say such words.

choices.text: Demand to see her trump card
choices.description: He would engage in psychological warfare, but didn't want to waste time beating around the bush. If they were to cooperate, she needed to show real chips.
choices.visible_reward: Skip the testing phase and go straight to the core
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might raise her cooperation terms because of this.

dialogue.content: "Enough." Chen Ji cut her off, his voice light yet carrying undeniable pressure. "We're not children anymore, there's no need for guessing games.\n\nHe raised his eyes, staring directly at Ye Qing: "I won't object to you killing the Holy Sect Leader. But I need to know why—and what you can offer me in return."

Ye Qing's expression changed.

The mask of world-weariness was peeled away, revealing a face both exhausted and resolute. She reached out and traced a strange rune in the air, and a wisp of black energy seeped from her palm.

"See clearly what this is."

In the black energy appeared a jet-black mark, radiating a chilling aura—with patterns surprisingly similar to some on Chen Ji's Tianji Record.

"The Holy Sect Leader is not just the Demonic Path supreme, he's a collector of ancient secret treasures." Ye Qing's voice was low. "A fragment of the Tianji Record lies in his treasury."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat.

The Tianji Record fragment. Master Mo had told him the Tianji Record was divided into nine volumes, and what he currently held was merely the opening section of the first volume. Each volume contained secrets capable of overturning the world.

If Ye Qing was telling the truth, then the fragment in the Holy Sect Leader's possession was the key to completing the Tianji Record.

"So you're not trying to kill him." Chen Ji spoke slowly. "You want to use my hands to help you reclaim what belongs to you."

Ye Qing did not deny it, simply watching him quietly.

dialogue.content:
"I am the Holy Sect Saintess, yet also a puppet controlled by forbidden arts." Ye Qing revealed her vulnerable side before him for the first time. "This fragment is the sacred artifact our clan has guarded for generations, forcibly taken by that villain a hundred years ago.

She raised her head, hatred burning in her eyes: "He intends to hold a sacrificial ceremony, ostensibly to unseal the forbidden grounds, but in truth, he wants to use your sister's Heaven-Gifted Dao Bone to activate the stolen fragment!

"Once he succeeds, your sister will die, and the Tianji Record will fall completely under his control. Both you and I will become his chess pieces."

text.content:
The secret chamber fell into deathly silence.

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, concealing the surging emotions in his gaze. For three years, he had believed himself all-knowing, treating everyone as pieces on a board. Yet he never imagined that the one truly being calculated was him from the very beginning.

Ling Yuan's protection, Xuanwu Sect's threats, Su Qingyao's approach... all clues pointed to one chilling possibility—he thought he was setting the board, when in reality he was merely a piece on someone else's chessboard.

"I remember." He spoke softly, his voice terrifyingly calm. "When I rescue Chen Nian, I will settle these accounts one by one."

Ye Qing looked at the man before her and suddenly felt an inexplicable chill.

She had witnessed Chen Ji's nonchalant demeanor when mocked at the Sect Competition, seen him skillfully navigate Ling Yuan's probes, but never this—beneath the calm surface, as if an ancient fierce beast was awakening.

"Three days." She withdrew her gaze, her voice recovering its usual composure. "The sacrificial ceremony will be held in three days. By then, most of the Holy Sect's experts will gather around the altar—this is our only opportunity."

She took out a black token from her sleeve: "This is an internal pass for the Holy Sect. With it, you can directly enter the periphery of the altar. The rest depends on yourself."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing provided crucial intelligence and a pass. Chen Ji was about to embark on the perilous journey to rescue Chen Nian. He needed to make the final decision.

choices.description: Since her goal aligned with his, there was no need for mutual suspicion. In this gambit, he chose to fight side by side with her.
choices.visible_cost: To entrust one's back to a person not fully understood
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's full assistance and reduce operational risk
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing had other schemes, he would fall into a desperate situation

text.content:
Chen Ji reached out and took the token.

The token felt cool in his palm, yet strangely brought him a sense of reassurance. He looked at Ye Qing and saw, for the first time, genuine respect in her eyes.

"See you at the Holy Sect in three days." He said.

Ye Qing nodded lightly and vanished into the shadows. The secret chamber was left with only him and the suffocating silence.

choices.description: Trust is trust, but one shouldn't bet all chips on a single person. He needed to prepare his own trump card.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to fully commit to the operation
choices.visible_reward: Keep an escape route, flexible in advancing or retreating
choices.risk_hint: Distributing energy might affect the operation's success rate

text.content:
Chen Ji took the token but stored it in his sleeve instead of hanging it at his waist.

Ye Qing noticed this small action but merely smiled faintly, saying nothing. She knew this man would not easily entrust his fate to others.

"As you wish." She said. "In three days, you'll know who is truly trustworthy."

choices.description: Ye Qing can be trusted, but having one more ally within the Tianqing Sect would greatly increase the success rate.
choices.visible_reward: Gain an insider and backup support
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might be manipulated by Ling Yuan

dialogue.content:
"Wait." Chen Ji called out to Ye Qing, who was about to leave. "I need to handle Su Qingyao first."

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, seemingly amused by his caution: "You suspect her?"

Chen Ji didn't answer, only saying calmly: "Not suspect. Confirm. Three days is enough time for me to see through many things."

text.content:
After Ye Qing left, the secret chamber fell into silence once more.

Chen Ji took out a yellowed paper talisman from his chest—this was the lifesaving trump card Mo Xiansheng had left him, capable of summoning a wisp of remnant soul power in critical moments. It could only be used once before being destroyed.

He stared at the twisted patterns on the talisman, and Mo Xiansheng's parting words echoed in his mind: "The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the inevitable backlash of fate. Every step you take now is accelerating the arrival of that end."

But if he couldn't even protect his sister, what use was this chessboard of the world to him?

Chen Ji tucked the paper talisman close to his body and retrieved a small jade bottle from the hidden compartment. Inside were three elixirs emanating a ghostly blue glow—the "Soul-Devouring Pills" he had intercepted from a demonic cultivator two years ago. After consuming them, one could briefly conceal all traces of presence and spiritual fluctuation, invisible even to experts of the Nascent Soul realm.

The only side effect was that each pill would leave behind an insidious cold poison in the body, nearly impossible to purge. At his current cultivation level, he could only withstand two at most.

"Three days." he murmured quietly. "Enough time to accomplish much."

He cast one final glance at the Tianji Record Fragment suspended in the air. The prophetic text on the fragment had completely vanished, leaving only blank space.

Ever since learning of Chen Nian's whereabouts, the Tianji Record had not displayed any prophecies. This anomaly filled him with unspoken unease—could it be that Chen Nian's very existence was interfering with the Tianji Record's predictions?

Or was some terrifying force secretly watching his every move?

Regardless, these questions would have to wait until after he had rescued Chen Nian. The priority was to devise a flawless plan.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and pushed open the door of the secret chamber.

Outside, it was already deep night. The scattered lights of Tianqing Sect flickered in the distance like countless indifferent eyes watching coldly. He gazed toward the direction of the Holy Sect—where the person he most wished to protect in this life was waiting for his arrival.

Three days.

In three days, he would let everyone know that the name Chen Ji was no longer synonymous with "waste" and "menial servant."

He would teach those who dared to harm Chen Nian what true calculation without error meant.

The night was as dark as ink, swallowing his silhouette. A storm that would shake the world was about to arrive.
